items.label: ID Certificates
items.details: Minimum amount charged monthly to keep a certification active. This allows to generate advanced e-signatures tied to a user's wallet.

items.label: Sponsored transactions
items.details: Only the gas actually used is charged when sponsoring transactions, including relayer costs, processing fees and price fluctuations. Price is in Euro at currency rates updated every minute, with a minimum of 0.01€.

items.label: Advanced e-signatures
items.details: Advanced digital signatures with qualified certificates for signing legally binding actions that require high proof security.

items.label: Certified storage (1GB free)
items.details: Certified encrypted storage above 1GB is charged monthly for both organizations and personal workspaces. Data is timestamped, versioned, encrypted with keys derived from workspace members' wallets and pinned to a decentralized storage network. Your data is always backed up publicly and only workspace members can decrypt or modify it.

items.label: AI assistance (per 1M tokens)
items.details: Workspace assistance and assisted organigram generation include 5 successful requests before these rates apply.
